projects.name: Analytical Fingerprint Laboratory Building
projects.subtitle: Rehabilitation for AMGC

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

projects.description: Managed this government-client project through its complete lifecycle, from feasibility through construction and the defects-liability period. Led the architectural design work, mentored junior team members and collaborated with local craftsmen to create a feature wall using custom 3D tiles produced in the client's on-site ceramic workshop. Presented the building's hybrid-system design to the client and resolved equipment delays and post-handover technical faults.

projects.name: International School of Tanganyika
projects.subtitle: New Athletic Centre

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

projects.description: Led the architectural design and design-team direction through a full topographical resurvey, revised building-permit submission and statutory-compliance coordination. Directed the tender process to select a contractor based on professional track record, and presented project status, recommendations and key decisions to the client's board and representatives.

projects.name: Montessori Children's House and Primary School
projects.subtitle: Competition Entry · 2nd Prize

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

projects.description: Led the design team on a competition entry grounded in direct research into Montessori pedagogical principles. Conducted site visits at two locations to gather contextual data and speak with future users, directed development of the architectural concept and personally delivered the final competition pitch. The proposal received second prize.

projects.name: International School of Tanganyika
projects.subtitle: Classroom Blocks D & E

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

projects.description: Led the refinement of fixed-furniture detailing through construction, working closely with junior team members during the delivery phase. Supervised work during the defects-liability period and managed an additional scope covering the detailing and construction of the classroom blocks.

projects.name: CCBRT Maternity Hospital
projects.subtitle: Detail Design and Construction

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

projects.description: Led a team of architects in detailed design and production information for a healthcare facility with significant building-services complexity. Directed the overlay and review of design-development drawings to verify the placement of medical equipment against mechanical, electrical and plumbing services.

projects.name: Bank of Tanzania
projects.subtitle: New Mwanza Branch

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Assistant Architect and Interior Designer, Epitome Architects Limited

projects.description: Contributed across the full pre-construction lifecycle of a regional bank headquarters, from feasibility through tender award. Undertook comparative research visits to Bank of Tanzania branches in Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar and Dodoma; led office-space programming based on departmental requirements; coordinated with MEP engineers and specialist consultants; and contributed to a cost-reduction exercise that kept the project within budget. Also carried out site supervision during the initial construction phase.

projects.name: Tegelweg
projects.subtitle: 4-Bedroom Apartment
projects.description: Designed and developed in phases over five years, from an initial two-bedroom configuration to its current four bedrooms. The project became a working environment in which interior concepts, space planning and guest-experience decisions could be tested and refined through ongoing use. Designed for Jubili, a hospitality brand co-founded as part of establishing the practice.

projects.name: Brabbeegasse
projects.subtitle: Single-Unit Apartment
projects.description: Designed for Jubili as the hospitality brand expanded to additional properties. The project demonstrated how a rented apartment could be transformed to express a distinct brand aesthetic while remaining capable of being returned to its original condition at the end of the lease.
